items.title: Glanbia shares tumble 6% after Morgan Stanley cuts rating to underweight

items.title: What Could Morgan Stanley (MS) Tokenization Mean For Its Role In Markets?
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) is now actively using DTCC's Tokenization Service for U.S. equities and Treasuries. The bank has moved from an initial participant role to live user of the DTCC platform for tokenized securities. The DTCC service is designed to connect tokenized assets with existing post trade infrastructure used across traditional markets.
